text: dsh-sound-notification 是面向 DSH Web 界面的提示音插件。它向会话编辑器的 composer dock 注入扬声器徽标，并观察所有会话的运行与待交互状态；回复结束时播放上扬双音，出现问题或审批请求时播放另一组提示音。用户可点击徽标静音或恢复声音，静音偏好保存在当前浏览器中。使用浏览器 Web Audio，无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-sound-notification plays chimes in the DSH Web UI when a response finishes or a session needs a question or approval answered. A speaker badge in the composer dock toggles mute, with the preference saved in the browser. Audio uses Web Audio; no API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 回复完成时响一声提醒我。
有没有办法在其他会话需要我回答或审批时播放提示音？
I want an audible alert when a DSH response finishes, even in another session.
dsh-sound-notification 的功能「会话状态提示音」：观察所有会话的状态变化，回复结束时播放上扬提示音，出现问题或审批等待时播放另一种提示音。声音由浏览器 Web Audio 合成。
dsh-sound-notification 的功能「扬声器静音开关」：在会话编辑器底部栏显示扬声器徽标，点击即可静音或取消静音，并将偏好保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage 中。

dsh-sound-notification README · dsh-sound-notification：A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that plays a short chime when **any** session's
response finishes — so you hear it even when you're not in front of the machine.

dsh-sound-notification README · Features：- Distinct two-note sine chimes, for any session — including ones you are not
  currently viewing:
  - **Response finished:** rising (880 Hz → 1318.51 Hz)
  - **Question / approval asked:** down-up (987.77 Hz → 783.99 Hz → 987.77 Hz)
- Speaker badge in the composer dock: **click to mute/unmute**
- Mute preference persists per browser (`localStorage`)
- Audio is unlocked on your first click/keypress (browser autoplay policy) and
  can never take the UI down (all audio paths are exception-guarded)

dsh-sound-notification README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:sviktor75/dsh-sound-notification
```

No build step is required — the package ships plain JavaScript.

To pin a specific commit (recommended for stability):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:sviktor75/dsh-sound-notification#<commit-sha>
```

dsh-sound-notification README · Files：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the composition |
| `index.js` | Host half (no-op; the Client module owns the chime) |
| `client.js` | Client half: Web Audio chime, status watching, mute badge |
| `locale/en.json` | Plugin metadata for the plugin manager |
